text:
lina (People Ops): Heads-up: Ravi emailed asking to move his approved PTO from Sep 15-20 to Sep 22-24 due to a flight change. That original block overlaps the Sep 17 customer demo blackout window and a team code freeze. Managers can approve swaps but we need a coverage plan.

mark (Eng Manager): Which days exactly conflict with the demo? Is Ravi an owner for any demo artifacts?

lina (People Ops): The demo blackout is Sep 16-18. Ravi is listed as part-owner for the metrics dashboard and was scheduled for the dry-run on Sep 17.

tara (PM): We need at least one engineer who knows the dashboard in the dry-run. If Ravi is out, someone must be assigned to present and know the rollback steps.

ravi (backend): I can shift to Sep 22-24 instead, but I won't be available Sep 17 morning. I can do a recorded walkthrough and a quick handoff doc before I leave.

mark (Eng Manager): Handoff doc + recorded walkthough is ok but not sufficient for the live dry-run. Can you be available remote for the Sep 17 dry-run between 9-10am? If not, we need to assign a presenter.

ravi (backend): I can join remotely 9-9:45am then disconnect for the rest of the day. I won't have stable connectivity after 12pm.

lina (People Ops): Quick reminder of swap policy: managers may approve intra-year PTO date swaps if (1) team coverage remains >= 60% across working days affected, (2) a written coverage/handoff is posted to the team channel, and (3) any person with demo responsibilities is either present remotely for the live dry-run or explicitly assigned to a backup presenter. People Ops must be CC'd on ops-exception swaps for audit.

oliver (HR): Also note for the record: moving PTO within the same fiscal year doesn't affect carryover. If a swap pushes someone into the next pay period and they request payout, that's a separate payroll request.

mark (Eng Manager): Proposed coverage plan (to be posted to #eng-team):
```
Sep 15: ravi off - no deploys scheduled; kat covers daily stand
Sep 16: normal rota
Sep 17: ravi remote 9:00-9:45am for dry-run; emily covers live demo questions; kat knows rollback steps
Sep 18-20: normal (ravi originally booked)
Sep 22-24: ravi swapped PTO block
```
I will post this and tag @lina. If People Ops needs anything else reply here.

deploy-bot: Scheduled dry-run test: Sep 17 09:00 UTC.

tara (PM): Please ensure the rollback steps are in the handoff doc and that the dashboard runbook is linked.

lina (People Ops): Once the coverage plan is posted and mark replies "approved" here, I'll mark the swap in our records. Managers, use the approval reply so we have audit trace.

mark (Eng Manager): approved

ravi (backend): I posted the handoff doc and a short recording to the team channel. Thanks for accommodating.

lina (People Ops): Noted 1D filing swap record. If remote attendance fails on Sep 17, manager to escalate to People Ops immediately. Closing thread when the #eng-team post is confirmed.
